scenario: default seven-state real Core and Phaser Arcade, Windows
decision: REJECTED: candidate is an isolated production-City patch, NOT enabled in v0.99931z8; keep z7 siege, population-loss fallback, and 2/2/12 limits.

denominators.captureFrequency: deduplicated authoritative city-captured / city-recovered / capital-fallen actions per hostile-contact city-month; NOT battle win probability
denominators.rawContacts: registerSiegeContact callbacks, including rejected or repeated callbacks; never soldiers
denominators.strength: unique verified live User/Player/logical-unit bindings present near the city at settlement, per faction-city-month; position uses the active runtime authority; not proof each soldier touched the city
denominators.episodes: consecutive underSiege city episodes observed after monthly settlement, not individual army attempts; instant first-tick captures may not open an episode; CONTACT_ENDED does not identify retreat, defeat or treaty cause
denominators.casualties: world population delta around City.updateSiege, may include capture/terminal transaction loss; not asserted to be all local defenders

limitations: This new fixed-seed panel is not the older army-1..12 panel: zero unifications here cannot by itself diagnose the historical z6 18 -> z7 3 change. No political probabilities were changed.
Both variants have zero unification events in this panel; first-unification time, post-unification duration and re-fracture distributions are consequently unavailable.
Failure/withdrawal reasons are not canonical z7 events. No new failure narratives are published. Controlled tests do not establish natural rare-event frequency.

actualRelease.scope: old siege plus released deposition choice; six seeds at 100/200 years, not the rejected siege candidate
